remove_all_ticks: remove all tick marks and labels from a 2D grid of matplotlib subplot axes
create_plot_without_ticks: create a matplotlib figure with subplots that have all axis ticks and labels removed
clean_subplot_axes: clean up subplot axes by removing tick marks, tick labels, and spines on both axes
format_matplotlib_grid: format a grid of matplotlib axes by hiding all tick marks and labels for a clean look
review_remove_all_ticks: review the remove_all_ticks function that iterates over a 2D axes array to hide ticks
